en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
C-Cook? Just the two of us...?
D-Damn, virgin! You got balls, son!

You finally want a taste of my sweet, sweet
hair pie, huh!?

Hah-haha! Can't say I blame ya! If that's
whatcha want, I'll gladly serve it up!

Hope you're hungry, cuz this pie o' mine
comes in courses!

I'm fuckin' wet, though—sopping, even.
Anyway, what's gotten into you?

W-Wait...! D-Do you wanna drug me and
rough me up!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
